The '''Corrobor''' was a [[virtual reality]] attraction that [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] considered clever and was present at a [[funfair]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CNII" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> The Corrobor used a [[neuralstim booth]] in order to give the user the sensation of becoming a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] with all of its component parts.<ref name="CNII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Corrobor was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="CNII" />
